overview.title: Overview
overview.description: As a Product Designer on the Design System team, I helped evolve PC Financial's design system across web and mobile banking products. My work focused on improving consistency, scalability, accessibility, and collaboration between design and engineering while enabling product teams to build faster with shared foundations.

problems.title: Inconsistent experiences across products
problems.challenge: As PC Financial's digital products expanded, individual teams were solving similar UI problems independently. Components behaved differently across products, visual styles became inconsistent, and design decisions were often recreated from scratch.

solution.summary: I identified recurring UI patterns across multiple product experiences and transformed feature-specific solutions into reusable design system components.
actions: Aligned mobile and web behaviors where appropriate
Built reusable foundations instead of one-off solutions

impact: Enabled product teams to design from shared building blocks
Improved long-term scalability of the design system

problems.title: Design and engineering lacked a scalable implementation workflow
problems.challenge: As the design system matured, translating design decisions into development became increasingly inefficient. Colors, spacing, typography, and component values were manually interpreted, leading to inconsistencies between design and implementation.

solution.summary: I partnered closely with engineering to establish a scalable design token workflow. I led a proof of concept exploring token implementation and designed the token architecture that connected Figma foundations with development handoff.

impact: Established a foundation for future system scaling

problems.title: Limited documentation reduced adoption
problems.challenge: Without clear guidance, teams interpreted components differently, resulting in inconsistent implementation and lower confidence when contributing to the design system.

solution.summary: I established documentation standards that made the design system easier to understand, adopt, and contribute to. To encourage continuous alignment, I also facilitated weekly design system discussions where designers reviewed new patterns, aligned decisions, and shared feedback across teams.
actions: Hosted weekly design system alignment sessions

problems.title: Product requirements often introduced one-off solutions
problems.challenge: Feature teams frequently requested unique UI solutions that solved immediate problems but increased system complexity over time.

solution.summary: Rather than designing isolated features, I evaluated whether new patterns could become reusable system capabilities. Working closely with product managers and engineers, I translated product requirements into scalable design system solutions.
actions: Introduced new components only when justified

impact: Created a more maintainable component library

problems.title: Accessibility needed to be built into the system—not added later
problems.challenge: Accessibility considerations were often addressed during product implementation instead of being embedded within the design system itself.

solution.summary: I advocated for accessibility-first foundations by incorporating WCAG principles into reusable components and design standards.

impact: Enabled teams to build more inclusive experiences by default

problems.title: The design system needed continuous evolution
problems.challenge: As new products launched, gaps in the design system became more apparent. Without ongoing prioritization, the system risked becoming outdated and less useful for product teams.

solution.summary: I contributed to the long-term evolution of the design system by continuously identifying opportunities for improvement.

impact: Supported sustainable growth across multiple product teams

contributions.title: My Contributions

Designed reusable components and interaction patterns
